evidenceScope: Only a temporary SDK checkout is installed and rebuilt at the next minor version. Existing consumer sources, configurations and dist bytes are fingerprinted. Browser tabs execute the actual baseline and upgraded SDK files; incompatible-release probes are explicitly metadata-only.

checks.name: publish the existing eight builds into a separate store with their baseline SDK
an existing tab starts on SDK 1.3.1 and mounts only A
only an isolated SDK checkout is installed and rebuilt as 1.4.0 with a visible behavior change
activate only the SDK selection without rebuilding or republishing consumers
a previously opened tab keeps SDK 1.3.1 even when it mounts C after the upgrade
a new tab loads the actual SDK 1.4.0 remote while B/D artifacts and React/Context sharing remain unchanged
rollback selects the baseline SDK for new tabs without replacing the SDK in existing tabs
metadata-only next-major SDK and React-incompatible probes are rejected without changing the current selection
a failed selected SDK load stops a new boot without silently falling back to an older SDK
all original Shell/A/B/C/D sources, configurations and built bytes remain unchanged
